cuts.note: dataset-specific adaptations of the thesis box, NOT a reproduction of its thresholds

nominal_model_override_justification: The uncorrelated-background model does not describe the high-multiplicity tail. This is the SAME failure the thesis reports in 8.6.2 ("the uncorrelated background model fit underestimates the high multiplicity tail"), where it gives chi2/ndof = 11/5 at position 0; 46 of our 51.4 comes from multiplicity bins 3-4, and our sample is 1.6x larger so the same physical mismatch carries more leverage. It means the real background is not Poisson in time, which is a statement about the detector, not a defect in the extraction. The alternative is not better: the data-driven fit's p ~ 0.4 is an artefact of background run 6264 having 22 AmBe triggers, whose template uncertainty dominates the chi2 denominator from bin 2 up. Removing sigma_bkg moves that fit from 0.640 to 0.351 with chi2/ndof ~ 854 (scripts/diagnose_datadriven_chi2.py --source 6265 --bkg 6264). A fit that good for that reason is not evidence of a better model. delta_m (the signed distance to the data-driven fit) is therefore carrying real model uncertainty rather than noise, and the number should be read as preliminary until a background run with usable statistics exists.

joint_projection_interval.note: thesis convention; projecting a 2-parameter joint region onto one axis OVERCOVERS for that parameter

notes: delta_h (housing captures, thesis 8.7.2) is NOT EVALUATED: no MC housing-capture fraction has been supplied. The quoted total systematic is therefore incomplete and is a LOWER BOUND.

delta_bt is DIAGNOSTIC ONLY and is EXCLUDED from the systematic total: it was computed from trigger counts, not rates. Thesis eq. 8.9 uses f_B/f_S in Hz. Supply systematics.livetime_s per run in the config to get a publishable number.

goodness_of_fit.ndof_definition: thesis: n_bins - n_fitted (does not subtract the normalisation); standard: n_bins - 1 - n_fitted
goodness_of_fit.p_value_basis: 2,000 multinomial pseudo-experiments at the best-fit model
warnings: nominal model 'poisson' has p = 0.0000 < gof_min_p_value = 0.01: it does not describe the multiplicity distribution. chi2 = 51.4 over ndof_thesis=6 / ndof_standard=5.

caveats: background run 6264 has only 22 triggers in the denominator; its per-bin uncertainty dominates the chi2 and the data-driven interval will be correspondingly wide. Treat this model as a systematic cross-check, not the primary result.
background run 6264 has only 5 candidate-bearing events; the background template is nearly a delta at zero, which drives this fit toward the naive counting ratio.
